author: Nerdstalgic
description:
What if the biggest threat to movie theaters isn't audiences...but Hollywood itself?

When news broke that the upcoming Avatar: The Last Airbender movie had leaked online, many people immediately blamed piracy. But the leak may have revealed a much larger problem, one that has been quietly reshaping Hollywood for years.  Because somewhere along the way, studios stopped treating movies like events.

From Avatar to Star Wars, Netflix originals, and blockbuster franchises, the entertainment industry is facing a question it may not be ready to answer:

If every movie becomes content... do movies stop mattering?

title: The Real Problem Behind The Avatar Leak
